$comment: The trail's stops (GAME_DESIGN 12.1, 12.2): S3's two sample stops at the Sol Duc trailhead and the button between stops; S5's sample stops at Deer Lake and the rim, and the trail frame's chrome (the status line, the caption, the toolbar, the (i) square; the strip's mile is a number format, fmt.mile_marker). S15a's tailgate and S9's cards replace the sample stops. Drafts until B004 is answered; preview only.

trail.walk_on.ctx: Every trail stop's button to the next stop (GAME_DESIGN 12.1)

trail.sol_duc_trailhead.lot.text: The road ends in a ring of giant trees. You smell wet moss and the river.
trail.sol_duc_trailhead.lot.ctx: Sol Duc trailhead, the first stop: the road's end, where the loop starts

trail.sol_duc_trailhead.trail_mouth.text: The trail slips between two huge trunks. Sol Duc Falls is under a mile in.
trail.sol_duc_trailhead.trail_mouth.ctx: Sol Duc trailhead, the second stop: the trail into the trees toward the falls (0.8 mi)

trail.deer_lake_rim.deer_lake.text: You come out of the trees at a still lake ringed with firs. It is the last sure water before the crest.
trail.deer_lake_rim.deer_lake.ctx: S5's sample stop at Deer Lake, the first lake on the climb to the High Divide (GAME_DESIGN 4.3: the last sure water before the dry crest)

trail.deer_lake_rim.rim.text: The ground falls away into a bowl of pale rock and heather. You count the lakes twice and get two answers.
trail.deer_lake_rim.rim.ctx: S5's sample stop at the rim of the Seven Lakes Basin, looking down into it (4.3: far more than seven lakes)

trail.caption.ctx: The caption under the picture: the trip's day, the place, its elevation in feet as fmt.ft words it (12.2)

trail.status.sound_on.ctx: The status line's Sound toggle while sound is on; tap turns it off (12.2, 13.11; King's Quest's own words)

trail.status.sound_off.ctx: The status line's Sound toggle while sound is off

trail.status.menu.ctx: The ≡ button's spoken name, and the name of the sheet it opens

trail.toolbar.pack.ctx: The toolbar's first button: what's in the pack (12.2)

trail.toolbar.map.ctx: The toolbar's second button: the park map with your route (12.2)

trail.toolbar.log.ctx: The toolbar's third button: the hiker's log, day by day (12.2)

trail.choice.why.ctx: The (i) square's spoken name: it opens the Why sheet behind a choice's odds (12.1, 12.11)
